goal: About two days of recipe search around the B3-B7 flu recipes, organized as a tree: each round expands the best recipes with one- or two-setting changes.
problem_in_words: Flu admissions and flu ED share, weeks 1-4 ahead. Leave-one-season-out: each of 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 held out in turn; each fold trains on the other three of the four completed seasons 2022-23..2025-26. Training labels are the latest finalized future values. Training histories follow each recipe; evaluation inputs are three artificial preliminary histories drawn from the prescribed 2025-26 reporting process, shared by every recipe and seed.
selection_score: States/DC mean log(1 + admissions) WIS over every October-May reference date, horizons 0-3, tasks pooled as in FluSight's ranking (no per-location normalization); seasons weighted equally; mean over the two seeds. Lower is better. Coverage is reported, not used (user decision 2026-10-10).
expansion_rule: After each round, rank every node scored so far by the selection score.
Seed noise: pooled standard deviation of the two-seed difference across nodes of the round; a child counts as better than its parent only if its mean is lower by more than that noise.
Next round expands the four best nodes (at most two per family A/B), plus at most two nodes whose two seeds disagree most among the top ten (uncertain, possibly good).
Children of an expanded node: (a) combinations of the settings that improved it or its siblings, (b) not-yet-tried settings on the axes still open, (c) a finer value on an axis that helped.
Axes whose every child was worse than its parent by more than noise in two rounds are closed for that family.
Every round is a new planner experiment tree-20261010-rNN with its study file round-NN.json (parents recorded); decisions are appended below.

Amended 2026-10-10 after round 2: re-seeding showed round-1 winners were mostly seed luck (B_width256.lr_double 0.294 on seeds 44-45, 0.325 on 46-47). A node now needs at least four seeds before it is expanded or called better than its parent; new children get four seeds.
confirmation: When the time budget ends: the five best nodes retrained on new seeds 46-50 under the same problem, plus a forward-only check (models trained only on seasons before the evaluated one).
policy: Claude decides each expansion between rounds by the rule above (user decision 2026-10-10); the user may intervene at any time.
